response.sql: WITH behavior_counts AS (SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(ab.abhvreg) as count FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg INNER JOIN trader t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg GROUP BY t.tradekind), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count)::NUMERIC as total_count FROM behavior_counts), shares AS (SELECT bc.tradekind, bc.count, bc.count::NUMERIC / t.total_count as share FROM behavior_counts bc CROSS JOIN totals t), avg_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) as avg_val FROM shares) SELECT s.tradekind, s.count, s.share, s.share - a.avg_val as share_minus_avg FROM shares s CROSS JOIN avg_share a WHERE s.share > a.avg_val AND a.avg_val IS NOT NULL ORDER BY s.tradekind
